concerns: One MAJOR defect: dashboard.js:1276 reads `p.candidate_executor ?? p.executor` but shadow.ts emits `candidate_executor_used`. The executor column in the shadow variants strip always displays '—' instead of the actual executor value. All 565 tests pass. All other acceptance criteria pass.

findings.description: Shadow strip executor column always shows '—'. dashboard.js:1276 reads `p.candidate_executor ?? p.executor` but shadow.ts writes the field as `candidate_executor_used` in all payload paths. Fix: `p.candidate_executor_used ?? p.candidate_executor ?? p.executor ?? null`.
